entries.content: Combat is turn-based. The player acts first (Basic Attack, skill, or item), then the enemy counterattacks. After each turn, skill cooldowns drop by 1 and mana regenerates by 5.
Mana is the resource for casting skills. Max is 50. Mana regenerates 5 per turn. Basic Attack costs no mana, but Fireball and other spells do.
Use the direction buttons to move one tile at a time on the map. Dark tiles are walls and cannot be crossed. The glowing tile is the exit.
